caption: The video captures a translucent, pale pinkish-white dome-shaped object resting at the center of a flat red circular surface bordered by a cream-colored rim, set against a uniform light-gray backdrop. The red disc fills much of the lower half of the view. The dome's rounded, glossy top carries two bright specular highlights separated by a short distance, and its body shows faint internal cloudiness; the highlights shift subtly from frame to frame, while the object itself remains roughly centered on the red disc with no obvious translation or rotation. Its silhouette shows only a faint, slow change in the upper edge, and the thin red ring around its base appears to broaden only slightly. These minor changes appear to proceed gradually across the clip, with no discrete event marking their start or finish. The cream rim and gray background remain broadly featureless, framing the quiet, ongoing subtle changes of the dome in place.
